obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be at 75 mm above ground reference plane at the time of first contact with the bumper (see Figure 4), with a ±10 mm tolerance
obligations.ears: When the impactor first contacts the bumper, the bottom of the impactor (without parts needed for the purposes of launching and/or protection) shall be at 75 mm above ground reference plane (see Figure 4), with a ±10 mm tolerance.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: an allowance shall be made for the influence of gravity during the period of free flight of the impactor
obligations.ears: When setting the height of the propulsion system, an allowance shall be made for the influence of gravity during the period of free flight of the impactor.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be in "free flight" at the moment of impact
obligations.ears: When performing the bumper tests, the lower legform impactor shall be in "free flight" at the moment of impact.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be released to free flight at such a distance from the vehicle that the test results are not influenced by contact of the impactor with the propulsion system during rebound of the impactor
obligations.ears: The impactor shall be released to free flight at such a distance from the vehicle that the test results are not influenced by contact of the impactor with the propulsion system during rebound of the impactor.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: may be propelled by any means that can be shown to meet the requirements of the test
obligations.ears: The impactor may be propelled by any means that can be shown to meet the requirements of the test.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall have the intended orientation about its vertical axis, for the correct operation of its knee joint, with a yaw angle tolerance of ±5° (see Figure 3)
obligations.ears: At the time of first contact, the impactor shall have the intended orientation about its vertical axis, for the correct operation of its knee joint, with a yaw angle tolerance of ±5° (see Figure 3).

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: a horizontal and vertical impact tolerance of ±10 mm shall apply
obligations.ears: For the lower legform testing, a horizontal and vertical impact tolerance of ±10 mm shall apply.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: may verify at a sufficient number of measuring points that this condition can be met and the tests are thus being conducted with the necessary accuracy
obligations.ears: The test laboratory may verify at a sufficient number of measuring points that this condition can be met and the tests are thus being conducted with the necessary accuracy.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall not contact the ground or any object which is not part of the vehicle
obligations.ears: While the impactor is in contact with the vehicle, the impactor shall not contact the ground or any object which is not part of the vehicle.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.ears: When the impactor strikes the bumper, the impact velocity of the impactor shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: The effect of gravity shall be taken into account
obligations.ears: When the impact velocity is obtained from measurements taken before the time of first contact, the effect of gravity shall be taken into account.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall not exceed +/- 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact
obligations.ears: The tibia bending moments shall not exceed +/- 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be done with the flexible lower legform impactor in resting position prior to the test/acceleration phase
obligations.ears: The offset compensation shall be done with the flexible lower legform impactor in resting position prior to the test/acceleration phase.
